answer: Because the timing is recorded against the atlas challenge, the sable audit can replay the dune history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 32 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3920 identities would post 4644 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
